home.title: NowCoding
home.headline: See what people are building right now
home.subtitle: NowCoding turns live coding activity into a social profile for sharing the momentum of now.
home.activityProofDescription: The detailed usage trail behind the public profile.

setup.title: Set up NowCoding
setup.headline: Connect your local activity to a shareable Now profile
setup.description: Follow the setup flow to publish coding activity without changing your development workflow.
setup.pageHeadline: Start broadcasting your AI coding presence
setup.intro: Welcome, {name}. NowCoding publishes live status, cards, and badges after the CLI syncs, while this setup page checks readiness without displaying secret values.

database.label: Database
database.ready: DATABASE_URL is configured. Do not expose the connection string.
database.missing: DATABASE_URL is missing. Add a Supabase Postgres pooler URL, then redeploy.

token.label: API token
token.ready: NOWCODING_API_TOKEN is configured. The setup page never displays it.
token.missing: NOWCODING_API_TOKEN is missing. Generate one locally and add it in Vercel.
token.malformed: NOWCODING_API_TOKEN is malformed. Generate a new one with npx nowcoding gen-token.

profile.label: Profile
profile.default: NOWCODING_USERNAME is using the default value. Set your public handle.

setup.primaryCommandDescription: Install the global CLI, initialize this deployment endpoint, and start the background daemon that keeps your public presence fresh.
setup.sourceCommandDescription: Review and build the collector from GitHub source before trusting it with your local activity.
setup.deploySettingsDescription: Manage missing environment variables and storage from Vercel.

usage.title: Usage
usage.headline: Your coding activity, ready to share
usage.description: Track the signals that make your current work visible across social surfaces.
usage.pageDescription: A deeper breakdown behind your public NowCoding presence.
usage.costHidden: Cost is hidden for this profile.

empty.missingDatabase: Connect DATABASE_URL to show private usage analytics for this profile.
empty.loadFailed: Usage analytics could not be loaded right now.
empty.ready: No coding activity exists for this period yet.

models.title: Models
models.headline: Model context for coding activity
models.description: Reference model usage and pricing data without changing the public API contracts.
models.pageDescription: NowCoding uses these public per-token estimates to label usage costs. This page is a supporting reference for transparency, not a promise that provider billing will always match every account, region, discount, or request mode.
models.estimatorNote: The estimator intentionally stays conservative: it publishes the table NowCoding can reconstruct from aggregate token buckets and leaves account-specific billing adjustments outside the main product story.
